first_v2_preflight: invalid due current undervoltage/throttling; retained and excluded

latency_predictor.validity_condition: all per-window CPU frequency samples are at least 1350 MHz under performance governor with frozen V2 active cooling
latency_predictor.fallback: none; all declared cells must exist in every split

thermal_predictor.continuous_scaling: fit-split mean and population standard deviation

margin.latency_scope: separate epsilon_tau per action across all declared workload/background cells
margin.thermal_scope: one shared epsilon_T across all actions and declared cells

coverage.latency_covered: end_to_end_ms <= latency_prediction_ms + action_epsilon_tau_ms + 10.0 ms fixed buffer
coverage.thermal_covered: T_end_C <= thermal_prediction_C + shared_epsilon_T_C + 0.6 C fixed buffer
